description.name: Special Attack: Don't Let the Door Hit Ya
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rest in Peace]</color> Upon conclusion, automatically activates when at least 3 <color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> exist on the field:
Throws a hammer at enemies on the field, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
<color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> hit by this skill will be detonated, up to a maximum of 3 <color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color>. Generates mini cyclones based on the number of <color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> hit, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
If 3 <color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> are detonated at once, a giant cyclone is generated instead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Excuse Me
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Watch for the Chill
EX Special Attack: Rest in Peace
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Watch Out for Wind Chill]</color> automatically activates upon conclusion:
Consumes all <color=#ffffff><Term:1000039></Term></color> to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
For every 1 <color=#ffffff><Term:1000039></Term></color> consumed, deals an additional instance of <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> after the attack, and generates 1 <color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> at the current position;
When [Windswept] is triggered on enemies during this skill, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Eye of the Storm
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rest in Peace]</color> Generated after consuming <color=#ffffff><Term:1000039></Term></color>, lasts 30 seconds;
<color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> A maximum of 9 can exist simultaneously. When the limit is exceeded, the earliest generated <color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> will automatically detonate;
When hit by <color=#ffffff>[Special Attack: No Need to See You Off]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Burial Night Requiem]</color>, they will be detonated. If fewer than 3 are hit simultaneously, each <color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> position will generate 1 mini vortex that tracks enemies and deals <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>, lasting 1 second;
If 3 are hit simultaneously, 1 giant vortex will be generated instead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>, lasting 1 second.
When detonated by any means, <color=#ffffff><Term:1000040></Term></color> will emit an Explosive blast dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to nearby enemies.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Got Your Back
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a Strike against enemies ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist Points]</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Midnight Protocol
description.desc:
After using <color=#ffffff>[Defensive Assist]</color>, Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

name: Core Passive: First Embrace of the Fevered Night
Additional Ability: Porcelloy Heart
desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>[Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Rupture]</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>[Armorer]</color> Character, the following effects trigger:
Roxy's DMG increases by 8%. This effect scales with character Lv., increasing by 1.2% per level, up to a maximum increase of 80%.
When all squad members' attacks hit an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30%. This effect is removed when Daze ends. When an enemy becomes Stunned, the Daze duration is extended by 2s.
When an enemy is affected by <color=#FFFFFF>[Windswept]</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>[Contamination]</color>, <color=#A6C5FD>Wind direct DMG</color> and direct attack DMG that triggers [Contamination] dealt to the enemy is additionally increased by 8%.
When entering the battlefield, recovers 40 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The duration of <color=#FFFFFF>[Windswept]</color> effects applied by all squad members is extended by 20s.
When using <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack]</color>, Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30</color>% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: Core Passive: First Embrace of the Fevered Night
Additional Ability: Porcelloy Heart
desc:
For every 25 Energy consumed, gain 1 <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color>. <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color> has a maximum of 3.
When Roxy's initial <color=#ffffff>Energy Regen</color> exceeds 1.2, for every 0.01 exceeded, ATK increases by 5, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>560</color>, and Impact increases by 0.4, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>46</color>.
When <color=#ffffff>[Special Attack: Don't Let the Door Hit You]</color> hits an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>[Windswept]</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>[Contamination]</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>[Cleanse]</color>. The <color=#FFFFFF>[Contamination]</color> effect reverts to a <color=#FFFFFF>[Windswept]</color> effect.
When any teammate in the squad triggers <color=#FFFFFF>[Contamination]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Cleanse]</color>, or applies <color=#FFFFFF>[Windswept]</color> again to an enemy already affected by <color=#FFFFFF>[Windswept]</color>, for every 1% CRIT Rate Roxy has, all non-<color=#FFFFFF>[Armorer]</color> Characters in the squad gain increased CRIT DMG of the Contamination or Cleanse attribute and Wind attribute by 0.4%, up to <color=#2BAD00>23</color>%, and <color=#FFFFFF>[Armorer]</color> Characters gain increased Laceration DMG of the Cleanse attribute and Wind attribute by 0.2%, up to <color=#2BAD00>11.5</color>%. Each attribute buff lasts 50s; repeated triggers reset the duration.

1.desc: <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rest in Peace]</color> On hit, reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s; increases own CRIT DMG by 40%.

2.desc: <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Watch for Wind Chill]</color> Daze inflicted increases by 5%; each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> detonated grants 1 stack of <color=#ffffff>[Flow Momentum]</color>, up to a maximum of 3 stacks; when switching out during <color=#ffffff>[Spin]</color> state while <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Watch for Wind Chill]</color> is active, Roxy consumes all <color=#ffffff>[Flow Momentum]</color> stacks, with each stack consumed maintaining <color=#ffffff>[Spin]</color> state for 0.2s without consuming Energy, up to a maximum of 0.6s; when <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Watch for Wind Chill]</color> hits an enemy, increases the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 25%, lasting until the target recovers from the Stunned state.

4.desc: When launching <color=#ffffff>[Defensive Assist]</color>, Roxy recovers 1 Energy, up to 1 time per skill; when <color=#ffffff>[Dodge Counter: Giving Back]</color> hits an enemy, recovers 2 Energy, up to 1 time per skill; <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Requiem of the Buried Night]</color> DMG increases by 20%, and Daze increases by 10%.

6.desc: DMG dealt ignores 20% of the target's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG RES</color>; When <color=#ffffff>[Special Attack: Don't Bother Seeing Me Out]</color> detonates <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> to generate a giant wind vortex, the main target is afflicted with the <color=#ffffff>[Reverberation]</color> effect, generating a giant wind vortex at the target's position once every 3s, for a total of 2 additional giant wind vortices. Upon repeated triggers, the number of additional generations stacks.; The DMG Multiplier of giant wind vortices becomes 250% of the original, and Daze inflicted is increased by 30%.
